title: Single-Molecule Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization and Immunohistochemistry in Zebrafish Embryos
author: Keseroglu, Zinani, et al.
materials: Alexa Fluor 488 Goat anti-Chicken IgG Secondary Antibody
Nikon A1R GaAsP inverted confocal microscope

steps.title: Prepare PBSTX and buffers
steps.instruction: Top up PBSTX to a final volume of 50 mL (1× PBS, 1 % Triton X‑100). Prepare permeabilization buffer (995 µL PBSTX + 5 µL Triton X‑100 per tube, avoid bubbles). Prepare blocking buffer PBSTXBG (0.2 g BSA + 10 mL PBSTX + 100 µL GS). Prepare primary antibody solution (180 µL PBSTXBG + 1 µL chicken anti‑GFP; store remaining PBSTXBG at 4 °C). Prepare secondary antibody solution (380 µL PBSTXBG + 2 µL Alexa Fluor 488 anti‑Chicken + 1.1 µL Hoechst 33342 per tube).

steps.title: Remove PFA and initial wash
steps.instruction: Remove residual 4 % PFA from the embryos, then rinse once with 1 mL PBSTX.

steps.title: Wash embryos with PBSTX
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL PBSTX, shake the tube slowly in a horizontal position for 5 min. Repeat this wash two additional times (total three washes).

steps.title: Permeabilize embryos
steps.instruction: Remove the final PBSTX wash, add 1 mL permeabilization buffer, and shake slowly in a horizontal position for 1 h at 20 °C–25 °C, taking care not to introduce air bubbles.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Remove permeabilization buffer, add 1 mL PBSTXBG, and shake slowly in a horizontal position for 2 h at 20 °C–25 °C.

steps.title: Incubate with primary antibody
steps.instruction: Remove most of the PBSTXBG (leaving ~20 µL), add 180 µL primary antibody solution (final 1 : 200, 10 µg/mL). Shake the tube slowly with a 45° tilt for 20–24 h at 4 °C in a cold room.

steps.title: Wash after primary antibody
steps.instruction: Remove primary antibody solution, rinse with 1 mL PBSTX, add 1 mL PBSTX and shake slowly in a horizontal position for 10 min at 20 °C–25 °C. Repeat this wash two more times.

steps.title: Block before secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Remove PBSTX, add 1 mL PBSTXBG, and shake slowly in a horizontal position for 10 min at 20 °C–25 °C.

steps.title: Incubate with secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Remove most of the PBSTXBG (leaving ~20 µL), add 380 µL secondary antibody solution (final 1 : 200, 10 µg/mL secondary antibody; 27.5 µg/mL Hoechst). Shake slowly with a 45° tilt for 16 h at 4 °C in a cold room.

steps.title: Fix and store embryos
steps.instruction: Remove secondary antibody solution, rinse and wash embryos once with SSCT while shaking slowly in a horizontal position for 7 min at 4 °C. Rinse again and add 1 mL 4 % PFA. Embryos may be stored in the dark at 4 °C for up to 7 days.

steps.title: Dissect embryo and remove yolk
steps.instruction: Place the tube on ice, transfer one embryo to a 60‑mm petri dish containing SSCT. Using a microsurgical knife, cut off the head, then make small cuts in the skin and use a lash tool to gently remove all yolk until only the presomitic mesoderm (PSM) and 1–2 somites remain. Perform all steps in a dark room with minimal light exposure.

steps.title: Mount tissue on slide
steps.instruction: Place one drop of ProLong Gold antifade reagent on a glass slide, transfer the dissected tissue into the drop with a lash tool, and ensure the tissue is dorsoventrally flattened.

steps.title: Apply nail polish and coverslip
steps.instruction: Apply a consistent amount of transparent nail polish around the tissue, gently place a coverslip on top, and wait 5 min for the nail polish to dry before imaging.

steps.title: Store slides and image
steps.instruction: Keep the prepared slides in the dark at 4 °C and complete confocal imaging on the same day of preparation.
